body: RULE: a high P/E is benign when (a) a reverse DCF's implied growth is achievable, i.e., growth ~= reinvestment rate x incremental ROIC and the company can keep reinvesting at that rate; (b) the runway (market share, category formalisation, store count headroom) is long; and (c) current EPS is not peak-cycle. It is also benign when EPS is temporarily depressed (Trent at 155x in May 2020 on COVID EPS). EVIDENCE OF BENIGN: DMart 2017-21 (ROCE 20%+, sales +26%/yr, self-funded), Asian Paints/Pidilite/Page at 40-60x for 15 years (ROCE 25-60%), HDFC Bank at 25-35x with ROE 16-20%. WHERE IT TURNS REAL: (1) P/E ~2x the stock's own long median (Asian Paints 117 and Pidilite ~100 in 2021, Page 81 in 2022, DMart ~200 in 2021, Bajaj Finance 121 in 2021) was followed by 4-6 flat years despite EPS growth; (2) growth decelerates or a new competitor arrives (Birla Opus vs Asian Paints, quick commerce vs DMart, LFL slowdown at Trent); (3) price driven by rerating, not EPS (Tesla 2021). India base rate: after runs ending at P/E >= 70, 13 of 15 winners were lower 2-5 years later (insight:india-mb-pe70-exit). PRACTICAL TEST: reverse DCF at today's price; compare required 10-year EPS CAGR with the last 10 years and with reinvestment x ROIC; check P/E vs own 10-year median; ask whether the next 3 years' EPS growth is visible in unit data (stores, subscribers, volumes).

data.benign_if: implied growth <= reinvestment x incremental ROIC; long runway; EPS not at peak
data.real_if: P/E >= ~2x own median; growth slowing; competitor entry; rerating-driven price
data.test: reverse DCF + own-median P/E + unit-data visibility

title: Reading a high P/E: benign when reinvestment x incremental ROIC supports the implied growth

body: H1a 1/43 (Satyam FY08: Rs 5,000 cr cash earning far below FD rates while borrowing). H1b 3/42 (Vakrangee ROCE ~40% in a kiosk franchise; Manpasand outgrowing Frooti; Cox & Kings debt+receivables in an advance-paid model). H1c 2/43 (Wirecard third-party acquirers; Rajesh Exports ~1% margin on Rs 2 lakh cr). Winners 0/63, but winners' records list no 'tells', so H1b/H1c were not seriously searched on winners (outcome-aware coding). Blind proxy (ROCE>40% 3y or OPM +10pp in 3y) fired on 9/22 traps but 5/28 winners (Caplin, Tata Elxsi, CDSL, Palantir, Tesla) and missed Vakrangee. Verdict KEEP HARD; H1b requires a written peer + bottom-up unit-economics comparison, not a threshold.

data.verdict: keep hard; H1b needs written unit-economics check

title: H1 judgment fraud signals (fake cash / implausible economics / unverifiable profits): 6 of 39 known traps caught pre-T, 0 winners rejected; a blind ratio proxy does NOT reproduce H1b
